summary: Iteration 26 backend regression + new feature tests. Verified: (a) Pencairan Dana campus listing API now returns `students` (name+region), `expected_amount` (=recipient_count*3jt when no transfer), `remarks` array on stage_one/stage_two; per-region detail also exposes expected_amount and remarks. (b) Manual aggregate PUT stamps manually_edited=True/manually_edited_at/manually_edited_by AND API remarks include 'Data diedit oleh Admin' plus any admin note. Test restored the record. (c) New endpoints /api/student/disbursement-proofs (list) and /api/student/disbursement-proofs/{source_id} (download) properly scope by recipient_user_ids: seeded matching + non-matching campus_disbursements docs; list returns only matching, download returns 404 for non-recipient. Admin Wilayah 403 on student proof list. (d) Active-letter decision endpoint contract change verified: `workflow` is REQUIRED, and `apply_all` requires nonempty `source_ids`. Bulk approve is properly scoped: seeded rec A in src_a + rec B in src_b + quarantined rec in src_a; POST with source_ids=[src_a] processed exactly 1 (rec A); rec B stayed pending; quarantined rec stayed pending; all 8 UMT is_demo_active_letter candidates remained in wawancara before AND after. (e) Stale approval path: seeding a registration with status=ditolak then approving the recommendation marks the recommendation `stale` and leaves registration untouched. (f) Frontend selectors confirmed in source: campus-disbursements-table (10 columns: No, Nama Perguruan Tinggi, Jumlah Mahasiswa, Nama Mahasiswa, Nominal Pengajuan, Waktu Transfer, Nominal Transfer, Bukti TF, Keterangan, Rincian), campus-student-names, disbursement-remarks, preview-transfer-proof-{source_id}, 'Bukti TF {n}' label, transfer-proof-region-select, active-letter-workflow-selector, approve-all-active-letter-button, student-disbursement-proofs, student-proof-empty-state. Combined pytest run: 92 passed, 0 failed across test_disbursement_proofs_iter26.py (new) + test_active_letter_approvals.py (updated) + test_campus_disbursements.py + test_transfer_proof_region.py + test_transfer_financials.py. No persistent storage objects created; all temp campus_disbursements/beneficiary_sources with test_tag=TEST_iter26 or TEST_active_letter cleaned by module fixtures. Live Gemini upload path NOT exercised (per instruction). Browser E2E was blocked at login by known Emergent visual-editor DOM mutation issue (documented in iter25); frontend rendering verified via source inspection instead.

server.py:1583-1588 build_disbursement_remarks appends 'Data diedit oleh Admin' when manually_edited=True and additionally appends `notes`. combine_campus_stage line 1620 dedupes remarks across regions using dict.fromkeys – good.

DisbursementManager.jsx:302-315 headers exactly match the requested PDF layout (10 columns). campus-student-names data-testid is on the list at line 508; disbursement-remarks at line 540; preview-transfer-proof-{source_id} at 525 with label 'Bukti TF {index+1}'.
StudentDisbursementProofs.jsx:42+58 renders empty state with data-testid='student-proof-empty-state' and 'Bukti TF {n}' + 'Lihat Bukti TF' actions – aligned with spec.

Pydantic model ActiveLetterDecisionInput (server.py:430) has `workflow: str` REQUIRED but Pydantic returns 422 (not 400) for missing/invalid. The extra runtime check at line 2737 catches invalid workflow VALUES but validation-missing case still surfaces as 422. Consider making `workflow: Optional[str] = None` + manual 400 for consistency, but the current 422 is acceptable/HTTP standard.
Consider adding a role check test: super_admin (not just admin) also allowed on decision endpoint – present in code (PM_MANAGERS) but not covered by new tests.
